SELECT /*opening balance*/
	debit=CASE WHEN b.bal >= 0 THEN b.bal ELSE 0 END,
	date = :ad_startDate, 
	type = SPACE(100),
	remarks='Opening Balance',
	acc=SPACE(100),
	accounthead=SPACE(100),
	RegNo=SPACE(100),
	credit=CASE WHEN b.bal >= 0 THEN 0 ELSE ABS(b.bal) END,
	priority= -1,
	Opening=1
FROM
	(SELECT bal=sum(Debit-Credit) 
	FROM VirtualGl
	WHERE acccode in (select acccode from accounts where acccode IN (:ai_acccode)) and
		date < :ad_startDate) B
UNION ALL
SELECT /*Transaction Details debit=credit and credit=debit*/
	debit=d.credit,
	date = h.date,
	type = RTRIM(LTRIM(VC.SHORTNAME)) + '-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), h.glvochcode))),
	remarks=d.remarks,
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = h.acccode),
	accounthead= 
		CASE WHEN d.studentcode IS NULL THEN
			(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = d.acccode) 
		ELSE 
			(SELECT name + ' (' + regno + ')' FROM student WHERE student.studentcode = d.studentcode)
		END,
	RegNo=
		CASE WHEN d.studentcode IS NULL THEN NULL
		ELSE 
			(SELECT regno FROM student WHERE student.studentcode = d.studentcode)
		END,
	credit=d.debit,
	priority=0,
	Opening=0
FROM
	glheader h,
	gldetail d,
	vochercategory vc,
	accounts a
WHERE
	h.posted = 'Y' and
	h.glvochcode = d.glvochcode and
	h.vochcatcode = vc.vochcatcode and
	vc.journalvoucher = 0 and
	h.acccode in (:ai_acccode) and
	h.acccode <> d.acccode and 
	d.acccode = a.acccode and
	h.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate
UNION ALL

SELECT 
	debit = ISNULL(SUM(S.Amt), 0),
	date = :ad_EndDate,
	type = 'CSH-SALE',
	remarks='Total Invoices: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT COUNT(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE salecatcode = 3 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + 
			' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MIN(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE salecatcode = 3 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) +
			'-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MAX(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE salecatcode = 3 and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + ')',
	acc=(SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode IN (:ai_acccode)),
	accounthead='Cash Sale for the Period',
	RegNo=SPACE(100),
	credit = 0,
	priority=1,
	Opening=0
FROM
	(SELECT amt=ISNULL(Round(SUM(d.looseqty * d.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (d.looseqty * 
				(d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc)) * 
				d.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((d.looseqty * 
				(d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) -
				h.flatdisc) * (h.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
			Round( SUM((d.looseqty * (d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) + 
				h.misccharges + h.salestax - h.flatdisc, 0), 0)
	FROM
		saleledger h,
		saledetail d
	WHERE
		h.saleinvcode = d.saleinvcode and
		h.salecatcode = 3 and
		h.paymentacccode IN (:ai_acccode) AND
		h.posted = 'Y' and 
		h.accountfor='Y' and
		h.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate
	GROUP BY h.saleinvcode,
		 h.salecatcode, 
		 h.date,
		 h.discperc,
		 h.misccharges,
		 h.salestax,
		 h.InvGSTPerc1,
		 h.flatdisc) S 
HAVING SUM(S.Amt) <> 0
UNION ALL

				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc)) *

			ROUND( (SUM((d.looseqty * 
				(d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) -

SELECT 
	debit = ISNULL(SUM(S.Amt), 0),
	date = :ad_EndDate,
	type = 'CSH-SALE',
	remarks='Total Invoices: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT COUNT(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE salecatcode in (1,2) and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and amt <> 0 and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + 
			' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MIN(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE salecatcode IN (1, 2) and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and amt <> 0 and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) +
			'-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((SELECT MAX(SaleInvCode) FROM saleledger WHERE salecatcode IN (1, 2) and posted = 'Y' and accountfor='Y' and amt <> 0 and date >= :ad_StartDate and date <= :ad_EndDate), 7))) + ')',
	acc=(SELECT MAX(name) FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode IN (:ai_acccode)),
	accounthead='Received during credit sale for the Period',
	RegNo=SPACE(100),
	credit = 0,
	priority=3,
	Opening=0
FROM
	(SELECT amt=ISNULL(sum(h.amt), 0) + ISNULL(sum(h.cashcharged), 0)
	FROM
		saleledger h
	WHERE
		h.salecatcode IN (1, 2) and
		h.posted = 'Y' and 
		h.accountfor='Y' and
		h.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate AND
		(h.paymentacccode in (:ai_acccode) OR h.cashacccode in (:ai_acccode) )) S
HAVING SUM(S.Amt) > 0
UNION ALL

SELECT 
	Debit  = CASE WHEN H.ServiceCatCode = 10 THEN H.InvTotal ELSE H.CashCharged END,
	date = H.Date,
	type = 'SVC-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), H.ServiceInvCode))),
	remarks=h.remarks,
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = h.cashacccode),
	accounthead=	CASE WHEN h.studentcode IS NULL THEN
			(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = h.custcode) 
		ELSE 
			(SELECT name + ' (' + regno + ')' FROM student WHERE student.studentcode = h.studentcode)
		END,
	RegNo=
		CASE WHEN h.studentcode IS NULL THEN NULL
		ELSE 
			(SELECT regno FROM student WHERE student.studentcode = h.studentcode)
		END,
	Credit = 0,
	priority=7,
	Opening=0
FROM
	serviceheader h
WHERE
	(h.CashCharged > 0 OR H.ServiceCatCode = 10) and
	h.cashacccode in (:ai_acccode) AND
	h.posted = 'Y' and
	h.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	Debit  = 0.00,
	date = H.Date,
	type = 'SVCR-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), H.ServiceRInvCode))),
	remarks=h.remarks,
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = h.cashacccode),
	accounthead=	CASE WHEN h.studentcode IS NULL THEN
			(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = h.custcode) 
		ELSE 
			(SELECT name + ' (' + regno + ')' FROM student WHERE student.studentcode = h.studentcode)
		END,
	RegNo=
		CASE WHEN h.studentcode IS NULL THEN NULL
		ELSE 
			(SELECT regno FROM student WHERE student.studentcode = h.studentcode)
		END,
	Credit = CASE WHEN H.ServiceRCatCode = 13 THEN H.InvTotal ELSE H.CashCharged END,
	priority=7,
	Opening=0
FROM
	servicerheader h
WHERE
	(h.CashCharged > 0 OR H.ServiceRCatCode = 13) and
	h.cashacccode in (:ai_acccode) AND
	h.posted = 'Y' and
	h.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate
UNION ALL

SELECT /*Sales Receivable Adjustments*/
	debit=SUM(d.debit),
	date = :ad_endDate,
	type = 'SRADJ',
	remarks='Sales Receivable Amount Adjustment',
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = d.acccode),
	accounthead=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = d.acccode),
	RegNo=SPACE(100),
	credit=SUM(d.credit),
	priority=16,
	Opening=0
FROM
	saleledger sl, salereceivableadj d, accounts a
WHERE
	sl.posted = 'Y' and
	sl.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate and
	sl.saleinvcode = d.saleinvcode and
	d.acccode in (:ai_acccode) and
	d.acccode = a.acccode
GROUP BY
	d.acccode
UNION ALL
SELECT /*Post Dated Cheques*/

	date = notes.PostDate,
	type = CASE WHEN notes.NoteCatCode = 1 THEN 'NR' ELSE 'NP' END + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(Notes.VoucherCode, 10))),
	remarks=notes.Remarks,
	acc=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = notes.BankAcccode),
	accounthead=(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE accounts.acccode = notes.acccode),
	RegNo=SPACE(100),
	credit=CASE WHEN notes.NoteCatCode = 2 THEN notes.Amount ELSE 0 END,
	priority=17,
	Opening=0
FROM
	Notes
WHERE
	notes.posted = 'Y' and
	notes.PostDate BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate and
	notes.BankAcccode IN (:ai_acccode)
table.sort: opening D, if(debit>0, '', 'C') A, date A

objects.name: c_openbalance
objects.expression: abs(cumulativeSum( debit - credit for all ) + credit - debit )

objects.name: compute_5
objects.expression: if( cumulativeSum( debit - credit for all ) + credit - debit >= 0, '', 'Cr.')

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: if( cumulativeSum( debit - credit for all ) >= 0, 'Dr.', 'Cr.')

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: abs( cumulativeSum( debit - credit for all ) )

objects.name: c_sreceived
objects.expression: sum( case( remarks when 'Opening Balance' then 0 else debit) for all)

objects.name: c_spayed
objects.expression: sum( case( remarks when 'Opening Balance' then 0 else credit) for all)
